tasks.title: Add DTOs to TypeScript Types
tasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces matching backend DTOs for the promotion email management system.
tasks.details:
Add TypeScript interfaces to src/types/index.ts:
- PromotionEmailTemplateDTO - Full template data
- PromotionEmailTemplateFormDTO - Form data for create/update
- SendPromotionEmailDTO - Email sending request
- PromotionEmailSentLogDTO - Sent email log entry

Ensure interfaces match backend OpenAPI schema exactly, include optional fields with proper types, add JSDoc comments, and export all interfaces.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that all TypeScript interfaces match the backend OpenAPI schema exactly. Test with sample data to ensure type safety.

tasks.title: Create Template List/Create Proxy
tasks.description: Create proxy handler for GET (list) and POST (create) operations for promotion email templates.
tasks.details:
Create proxy handler in src/pages/api/proxy/promotion-email-templates/index.ts:
- Use createProxyHandler from @/lib/proxyHandler
- Set backendPath: '/api/promotion-email-templates'
- Support query parameters: eventId.equals, isActive.equals, sort, page, size
- Follow cursor rules: no local DTO declarations, use fetchWithJwtRetry
tasks.testStrategy: Test the proxy by making GET and POST requests and verifying the correct responses. Test with various query parameters.

tasks.title: Create Template Get/Update/Delete Proxy
tasks.description: Create proxy handler for single template operations (GET, PATCH, DELETE).
tasks.details:
Create proxy handler in src/pages/api/proxy/promotion-email-templates/[...slug].ts:
- Use createProxyHandler from @/lib/proxyHandler
- Set backendPath: '/api/promotion-email-templates'
- Support GET (by ID), PATCH (update), DELETE operations
- Handle slug pattern: ['id'] or ['id', 'send-test'] or ['id', 'send-bulk']
tasks.testStrategy: Test GET, PATCH, and DELETE operations with valid and invalid IDs. Verify correct handling of different slug patterns.

tasks.title: Create Email Sending Proxy Routes
tasks.description: Create proxy handlers for test and bulk email sending endpoints.
tasks.details:
Create proxy handlers for email sending:
- src/pages/api/proxy/promotion-email-templates/[id]/send-test.ts
- src/pages/api/proxy/promotion-email-templates/[id]/send-bulk.ts

Requirements:
- Use createProxyHandler or custom handler
- POST method only
- Forward request body to backend
- Handle errors gracefully
tasks.testStrategy: Test sending test and bulk emails with valid and invalid data. Verify error handling for various scenarios.

tasks.title: Create Email Log Proxy
tasks.description: Create proxy handler for querying email logs with filtering and pagination.
tasks.details:
Create proxy handler in src/pages/api/proxy/promotion-email-sent-logs/index.ts:
- Use createProxyHandler
- Set backendPath: '/api/promotion-email-sent-logs'
- Support filtering: eventId.equals, templateId.equals, sentAt.greaterThanOrEqual, sentAt.lessThanOrEqual, emailStatus.equals
- Support pagination: sort, page, size
tasks.testStrategy: Test the proxy with various filter combinations and pagination parameters. Verify correct data is returned.

tasks.title: Create ApiServerActions.ts
tasks.description: Create server actions for all API calls related to promotion email templates.
tasks.details:
Create server actions in src/app/admin/promotion-emails/ApiServerActions.ts with functions:
- fetchPromotionEmailTemplatesServer(params)
- fetchPromotionEmailTemplateServer(id)
- createPromotionEmailTemplateServer(formData)
- updatePromotionEmailTemplateServer(id, formData)
- deletePromotionEmailTemplateServer(id)
- sendTestEmailServer(templateId, recipientEmail)
- sendBulkEmailServer(templateId, recipientEmails?)
- fetchPromotionEmailSentLogsServer(params)

All functions must use fetchWithJwtRetry, getAppUrl for absolute URLs, handle errors with try-catch, return typed responses, and use withTenantId for DTOs.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each server action with valid and invalid inputs. Verify correct error handling and response types.

tasks.title: Create PromotionEmailTemplateList Component
tasks.description: Build a component to display a list of email templates with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
tasks.details:
Create component in src/app/admin/promotion-emails/components/PromotionEmailTemplateList.tsx with features:
- Display template name, event, subject, status
- Filter by event (dropdown)
- Search by template name
- Sort by created date, name
- Pagination
- Actions: Edit, Duplicate, Delete, Send Test, Send Bulk

UI Requirements:
- Responsive design (mobile-friendly)
- Loading states
- Empty state message
- Error handling display
- Confirmation dialogs for delete
tasks.testStrategy: Test component rendering with various data sets. Test filtering, sorting, pagination, and all action buttons.

tasks.title: Create PromotionEmailTemplateForm Component
tasks.description: Build a form component for creating and editing email templates with all required fields.
tasks.details:
Create component in src/app/admin/promotion-emails/components/PromotionEmailTemplateForm.tsx with fields:
- Event (Select, required)
- Template Name (Text Input, required)
- Subject (Text Input, required)
- Discount Code (Select, optional)
- Header Image (Image Upload, optional)
- Footer Image (Image Upload, optional)
- Body HTML (Rich Text Editor, required)
- Active Status (Toggle, optional)

Requirements:
- Form validation
- Event selector loads events from API
- Discount code selector updates when event changes
- Option to create new discount code inline
- Image upload with drag-and-drop
- Image preview before saving
- Rich text editor for HTML body
- Live preview of email template
- Save, Cancel, Send Test buttons
tasks.testStrategy: Test form submission with valid and invalid data. Test field validation, image uploads, and dynamic field updates.

tasks.title: Create ImageUpload Component
tasks.description: Build a reusable component for image uploading with drag-and-drop and preview functionality.
tasks.details:
Create component in src/app/admin/promotion-emails/components/ImageUpload.tsx with features:
- Drag-and-drop file upload
- File selection via button
- Image preview
- Image validation (size, format)
- Upload progress indicator
- Error handling
- Remove/replace image

Integration:
- Use existing media upload API or S3 upload service
- Return S3 URL after upload
- Store URL in form state
tasks.testStrategy: Test image uploads with various file types and sizes. Test drag-and-drop, file selection, preview, and error handling.

tasks.title: Create PromotionEmailHistory Component
tasks.description: Build a component to display sent email logs with filtering and details view.
tasks.details:
Create component in src/app/admin/promotion-emails/components/PromotionEmailHistory.tsx with features:
- Table showing: recipient, subject, sent date, status
- Filter by event, date range, status
- Search by recipient email
- Pagination
- View email details modal
- Resend failed emails

Status Indicators:
- SENT - Green badge
- FAILED - Red badge
- BOUNCED - Orange badge
tasks.testStrategy: Test component with various log data. Test filtering, pagination, details view, and resend functionality.

tasks.title: Redesign Promotion Emails Page
tasks.description: Implement the main promotion emails page with all components integrated.
tasks.details:
Redesign page in src/app/admin/promotion-emails/page.tsx with structure:

1. Header Section
   - Page title: "Promotion Email Management"
   - Create New Template button
   - Admin Navigation component

2. Template Management Section
   - Template list component
   - Filters and search
   - Template actions

3. Template Form Section
   - Show/hide based on create/edit mode
   - Template form component
   - Form actions

4. Email History Section
   - Tab or accordion for history
   - Email history component

State Management:
- Selected template (for edit mode)
- Form mode (create/edit/view)
- Loading states
- Error messages
- Success messages
tasks.testStrategy: Test the complete page flow including creating, editing, and deleting templates. Test navigation between different sections.

tasks.title: Integrate Event Selector
tasks.description: Integrate existing event selection functionality with the template form.
tasks.details:
Integrate event selector with the template form:
- Reuse fetchEventsFilteredServer from admin API
- Filter events by tenant
- Display event title and date
- Handle event selection
- Update dependent fields when event changes
tasks.testStrategy: Test event selection with various tenant filters. Test that dependent fields update correctly when event changes.

tasks.title: Integrate Discount Code Selector
tasks.description: Integrate discount code selection functionality with the template form.
tasks.details:
Integrate discount code selector with the template form:
- Use fetchDiscountCodesForEvent from discount code API
- Update dropdown when event changes
- Display code, type, value, validity
- Option to create new discount code (link to discount code page)
tasks.testStrategy: Test discount code selection with various events. Test that the dropdown updates correctly when event changes.

tasks.title: Integrate Rich Text Editor
tasks.description: Integrate a rich text editor for the email body HTML field.
tasks.details:
Integrate rich text editor for HTML body:
- Use React Quill, TinyMCE, or similar library
- Support HTML editing
- Preview mode
- Sanitize HTML output
- Handle content changes in form state
tasks.testStrategy: Test rich text editor functionality including formatting, HTML editing, and preview. Test that content is correctly saved in form state.

tasks.title: Add Loading States
tasks.description: Implement loading states for all asynchronous operations.
tasks.details:
Add loading states throughout the application:
- Loading spinners for API calls
- Skeleton loaders for lists
- Disabled buttons during operations
- Implement consistent loading state management
tasks.testStrategy: Test loading states by simulating slow network responses. Verify that UI elements are appropriately disabled during loading.

tasks.title: Add Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling for all operations.
tasks.details:
Add error handling throughout the application:
- Display error messages clearly
- Handle validation errors
- Handle network errors
- Implement retry mechanisms
- Show user-friendly error messages
tasks.testStrategy: Test error handling by simulating various error conditions including validation errors, network errors, and server errors.

tasks.title: Add Success Feedback
tasks.description: Implement success feedback for all user actions.
tasks.details:
Add success feedback throughout the application:
- Success toast notifications
- Confirmation messages
- Auto-refresh lists after operations
- Clear feedback for completed actions
tasks.testStrategy: Test success feedback for all user actions including create, update, delete, and send operations.

tasks.title: Add Form Validation
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive form validation for the template form.
tasks.details:
Add form validation to the template form:
- Client-side validation
- Real-time error messages
- Required field indicators
- Format validation (email, URLs)
- Prevent submission of invalid forms
tasks.testStrategy: Test form validation with various invalid inputs. Test that submission is prevented for invalid forms and that error messages are displayed correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Responsive Design
tasks.description: Ensure all components are responsive across different screen sizes.
tasks.details:
Implement responsive design throughout the application:
- Mobile-first approach
- Support breakpoints: sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px)
- Table should scroll horizontally on mobile
- Form should stack vertically on mobile
- Buttons should be full-width on mobile
- Image upload should work on touch devices
tasks.testStrategy: Test the application at various screen sizes and breakpoints. Verify that all components are usable on mobile devices.

tasks.title: Implement Accessibility Features
tasks.description: Ensure the application meets accessibility standards.
tasks.details:
Implement accessibility features throughout the application:
- Proper ARIA labels on all interactive elements
- Keyboard navigation support
- Focus indicators
- Screen reader support
- Color contrast compliance (WCAG AA)
- Alt text for images
tasks.testStrategy: Test accessibility using screen readers and keyboard navigation. Verify color contrast compliance with WCAG AA standards.
